details:
Project Details – Space Mission Workshop

Space Mission Workshop is an interactive educational browser game designed to introduce players to the challenges of planning space exploration missions.

The game allows players to choose between three different missions: Mars Exploration, Moon Research, and Asteroid Observation. For each mission, players select scientific equipment while managing three important resources: mass, energy, and credits. Each choice affects the mission plan. After completing a mission, players receive a mission report, earn points, and unlock achievements.

The main benefit of this project is that it makes space mission planning easier to understand through an interactive and engaging experience. Instead of only reading about space exploration, players can actively make decisions, explore different possibilities, and learn about resource management.

The intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space, improve problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, and make scientific concepts more accessible to students and beginners.

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. HTML was used to structure the game, CSS to create its visual design and animations, and JavaScript to build the interactive game mechanics, resource system, scoring, and mission reports. ChatGPT was used as an AI-assisted development tool for coding support and troubleshooting.

The creative aspect of the project is its combination of learning and gameplay. It transforms the idea of planning a space mission into a simple simulation where players learn by making decisions. The design also considers different mission requirements, equipment choices, resource limitations, and ease of use.

During development, we focused on keeping the game beginner-friendly, visually engaging, interactive, and easy to access through a web browser without requiring additional software installation.
